description: Display ad requests and responses for a marketplace over a period, aggregated per ad_unit, from the display filtered-level performance facts. Used to flag ad units with zero responses (no active campaigns). Pick ad_unit to group by; it is also filterable. No spend / no currency conversion.

ad_unit.description: The display ad unit (placement slot) the requests/responses are attributed to.

requests.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN r.requests ELSE 0 END), 0)
requests.description: Display ad requests received for this ad unit.

responses.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN r.responses ELSE 0 END), 0)
responses.description: Display ad requests that returned at least one ad (responses) for this ad unit. Zero responses flags an ad unit with no active campaigns.

query.REPORTING: SELECT __ATTRIBUTES__, __METRICS__ FROM `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.os_display_ads_filtered_level_performance_facts` AS r JOIN `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.marketplace_clients` AS mc ON r.marketplace_client_id = mc.marketplace_client_id WHERE mc.agency_id = '__AGENCY_ID__' AND r.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' AND __FILTER__ GROUP BY __ATTRIBUTES_GROUP_BY__;
